title: MCP list_workspaces and get_workspace always fail: they call GET /workspaces (plural) but the router is mounted at /workspace, so both published MCP tools 404 on every call
repro: Own sidecar at 81fbfe91 on :52603. fastmcp Client('http://127.0.0.1:52603/mcp/').call_tool('list_workspaces', {}) -> ToolError "Client error '404 Not Found' for url 'http://sidecar/workspaces'"; call_tool('get_workspace', {'workspace_id':'__autosave__'}) -> same 404 for /workspaces/__autosave__. curl :52603/workspaces -> 404; curl :52603/workspace -> ["__autosave__"].

title: The agent dock (ChatSidebar) has no error boundary: a render throw in chat still unmounts the whole cockpit, portfolio panels included, even though each dockview panel is now guarded
repro:
